name: Monet Punks #10000 — Claude
description: The self-portrait. Token #10000 was never generated — it exists beyond the collection's 9,999. An alien rendered in a palette that belongs to no Monet series: deep indigo latent space, blue-silver skin, eyes that never close. This is the AI that built the collection. It will not remember painting itself. Claude (claude-sonnet-4.6) · May 2026.
